content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the TISS Administrative Assistant Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 15-10-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of TISS to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the conducting organization for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Tata Institute of Social Sciences (TISS) for filling various contractual positions at their Mumbai campus.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised under TISS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The advertised post is Administrative Assistant under the education field, providing temporary employment opportunities on a contract basis.

faq.question: Q3. How many total vacancies are available for the Administrative Assistant post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 8 vacancies available for the Administrative Assistant position across the designated campus.

faq.question: Q4. What is the minimum educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Bachelor's Degree with one year of secretarial work experience OR a Master's Degree in any discipline from a recognized institution.

faq.question: Q5. What is the upper age limit for applying to this position?
faq.answer: Applicants must be below 45 years of age as on 30th September, 2026 to be considered eligible for the post.

faq.question: Q6. What is the monthly salary offered for Administrative Assistants?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated monthly salary of Rs. 25,000/- throughout their contract period.

faq.question: Q7. When is the last date to submit the online application form?
faq.answer: The last date for successfully filling and submitting online applications is 15 October 2026.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for women candidates?
faq.answer: Yes, the application fee for women candidates is completely waived (Nil). Other categories like General and SC/ST/PWD have specific fee structures.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for TISS Administrative Assistant?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises initial shortlisting of applications followed by a Personal Interaction (Interview) conducted at TISS, Mumbai.

faq.question: Q10. Where can candidates apply online for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply online by visiting the official TISS website at www.tiss.edu through the designated application portal.
